title: Pin tumbler lock
prompt: how does a key open a lock? a pin tumbler door lock modelled large: insert the right key, the pins line up at the shear line, turn, the bolt withdraws; try a wrong key and it won't turn; see-through shows key pins, driver pins, springs, plug, shear line, cam and deadbolt
blurb: A euro cylinder and mortise deadbolt cut open: the right key lifts all five pin stacks to the shear line so the plug can turn and the cam throws or pulls the bolt, while a wrong key leaves pins across the line and the plug only rocks.
